# FusionSynergy

> AI-powered fintech platform for practice trading, market intelligence, and learning the markets — built for beginners and experts alike.

FusionSynergy ("FUSE") combines live market data, a conversational AI assistant (FUSE AI), and a risk-free practice trading environment. The long-term vision spans quantum computing, multi-agent AI, biotech, and cybersecurity.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Portfolio overview, market movers, and quick access to FUSE AI.
- [Invest](/invest): Sector maps, themes, and trending stocks.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Holdings, sector mix, and performance vs major indices.
- [Discover](/discover): Trending stocks, themes and screeners.
- [FUSE AI](/ai): Conversational market intelligence and analysis.
- [Community](/discussion): Discussion feed for trading ideas.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Streaks and rankings.
- [Orders](/orders): Practice trade history.
- [Learn](/learn): Short lessons for new traders.
- [Our Projects](/projects): Flagship and upcoming FusionSynergy projects.
- [Help & FAQ](/help): Common questions about the platform.

## Optional

- [Settings](/settings): Account preferences.
